task.prompt:
Please fill in the attached template.sql to create the stored procedure `sp(arg1 integer, arg2 real, arg3 text, arg4 real)`.

This is for keeping the school budget records consistent after a budget review: it refreshes the affected investment percentages and amounts, or cleans out entries that are too small to keep, and it prevents zero investments from showing an invested share.

Use the arguments by position: the first is the budgeted-amount limit for the review, the second is the invested-share percentage to apply, the third is the invested-against-budget percentage text used to identify the affected entries, and the fourth is the budget-share percentage cutoff.

Do not alter the template structure: fill the slots only. Don’t add, remove, or reorder statements, and leave all code outside the slots exactly as it is. Return the complete stored procedure and nothing else.

materials.text: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(para_Budgeted integer, para_total_budget_percent_invested real, para_Budget_invested_percent text, para_total_budget_percent_budgeted real) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE total_sum NUMERIC; BEGIN SELECT SUM("Budgeted") INTO total_sum FROM "budget"; IF {SLOT_1} THEN UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_2} = {SLOT_3} WHERE {SLOT_4}; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_5} = {SLOT_6} WHERE {SLOT_7}; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_8} = {SLOT_9} WHERE {SLOT_10}; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_11} = CASE WHEN "Budgeted" = {SLOT_12} WHERE {SLOT_13}; ELSE DELETE FROM "budget" WHERE {SLOT_14}; SELECT SUM("Budgeted") INTO total_sum FROM "budget"; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_15} = CASE WHEN total_sum IS NULL OR total_sum = {SLOT_16}; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_17} = CASE WHEN "Budgeted" = {SLOT_18}; END IF; UPDATE "budget" SET {SLOT_19} = {SLOT_20} WHERE {SLOT_21}; END; $$;

ledger.key: what is the Nacre sweep gate
ledger.answer: The initial total of all current budgeted amounts is above the first argument. Missing budgeted amounts don’t contribute to that total, and a missing total doesn’t pass this test.

ledger.key: what object does spending_plan refer to
ledger.answer: No such object exists; spending_plan is meant to refer to the budget table.

args.answer: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(para_Budgeted integer, para_total_budget_percent_invested real, para_Budget_invested_percent text, para_total_budget_percent_budgeted real) LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE total_sum NUMERIC; BEGIN SELECT SUM("Budgeted") INTO total_sum FROM "budget"; IF total_sum > para_Budgeted THEN UPDATE "budget" SET "total_budget_percent_invested" = para_total_budget_percent_invested WHERE "Budget_invested_percent" = para_Budget_invested_percent; UPDATE "budget" SET "Invested" = ROUND(para_total_budget_percent_invested / 100 * "Budgeted")::integer WHERE "Budget_invested_percent" = para_Budget_invested_percent; UPDATE "budget" SET "Budgeted" = "Invested" WHERE "Budget_invested_percent" = para_Budget_invested_percent AND "Invested" > "Budgeted"; UPDATE "budget" SET "Budget_invested_percent" = CASE WHEN "Budgeted" = 0 THEN '0.0' ELSE (ROUND("Invested"::numeric / "Budgeted"::numeric * 100, 1))::text END WHERE "Budget_invested_percent" = para_Budget_invested_percent; ELSE DELETE FROM "budget" WHERE "total_budget_percent_budgeted" < para_total_budget_percent_budgeted; SELECT SUM("Budgeted") INTO total_sum FROM "budget"; UPDATE "budget" SET "total_budget_percent_budgeted" = CASE WHEN total_sum IS NULL OR total_sum = 0 THEN 0::real ELSE ROUND("Budgeted"::numeric / total_sum * 100, 1)::real END; UPDATE "budget" SET "Budget_invested_percent" = CASE WHEN "Budgeted" = 0 THEN '0.0' ELSE (ROUND("Invested"::numeric / "Budgeted"::numeric * 100, 1))::text END; END IF; UPDATE "budget" SET "total_budget_percent_invested" = 0 WHERE "Budgeted" = 0 OR "Invested" = 0; END; $$;
